title: Racine County Eye Hosts Two Halloween Season Events with Racine Paranormal Investigators 2026
excerpt: Lead Racine Paranormal Investigators Ron Helmick and medium Michael Sorensen open up the paranormal field on Oct. 17, then a live "Made in Racine" recording digs into Brossman's Bar on Nov. 2. Tickets are $25.
content:
Follow us

Racine County Eye is marking Halloween with two events alongside Racine Paranormal Investigators, one on Saturday, Oct. 17, and one on Monday, Nov. 2.

The first digs into the work of a paranormal investigator. The second covers a local haunt: Brossman’s Bar in Franksville. Both will be held at Racine County Eye’s office, 1926 Albert St., Suite 201, above Lee’s Market.

Racine Paranormal Investigators is a local group that investigates spirits and locations throughout the area.

Lead investigator Ron Helmick and medium Michael Sorensen will peel back the curtain on paranormal investigations, sharing stories and demonstrating their equipment. The Oct. 17 session runs from 3 to 5 p.m., and guests can take part in an optional medium demonstration at the end.

“We want to share some in-depth knowledge of the paranormal field from our perspective. There’s no such thing as an expert because we are always learning about the universe of paranormal,” Helmick said.

When asked what he is most looking forward to, Sorensen said: “For myself, I would say, communication with the other side has many different levels to it. Showing the continuity of life and to show it can be a loving experience!”

Made in Racine: Brossman’s Bar

In 2014, Racine County Eye owner Denise Lockwood covered the haunted bar in Franksville. That story reported employees and patrons alike had seen several ghosts in the building, which has served as a bar, and before that as a stagecoach stop and hotel. The business was in the Brossman family since 1899.

The Nov. 2 event is a live recording of Racine County Eye’s podcast “Made in Racine,” featuring Helmick, his team of investigators, and the Brossman’s employees who took part in the 2014 investigation. It runs from 6 to 8 p.m. at the Racine County Eye office, not at the bar.

Racine County Eye debuted “Made in Racine” with Racine Paranormal Investigators last October and has worked with the Investigators over the last 12 years.

Ticket information

Tickets for both events are $25 and can be purchased here. Celebrate Halloween and peer behind the veil in Racine.

Racine County Eye is hosting both events.
